equivalence_argument: For finite integral weights and binary recurrent spikes, each selected product is exactly represented. Original per-destination absolute sum 69948 bounds all intermediate partial sums below 2^24, so ordinary float32 reduction order cannot change nonzero sums. Exact integer float64 accumulation followed by float32 conversion preserves the same integers. Signed zero, duplicate/ordering/mapping, batch and surrounding state transition still need complete execution-mode evidence. Keep the 0.275 scale after the sum.
reference_reuse_conditions: Retain the two actual original fresh executions. Bind exact ordered inputs, replay, initial state, parameters, relevant engine/setup and generated source, compiler/native build, device, threads/reduction and capture coverage. Current globally loaded-module hashes need a verified engine dependency boundary. For cross-engine state budgets, retain raw complete relevant-prefix reference values or regenerate them through digest-verified deterministic replay; existing phase digests alone are insufficient.
